hero.title: File:Four Courts Conflagration.jpg
hero.artist: National Library of Ireland on The Commons
hero.description:
The Four Courts in Dublin during the Battle of Dublin. The building had been taken over by Anti-Treaty forces on the date 14 April 1922. Bombarded by National Army forces on 28 and 29 June, a huge explosion of stored munitions on 30 June destroyed the Public Records Office, and with it a huge swathe of Irish cultural memory.
Date: 30 June 1922

NLI Ref.: HOG57

gallery.artist: National Library of Ireland on The Commons
gallery.description:
Maud Gonne McBride (far right) on duty with a relief agency in Dublin during the Irish Civil War. 4 July 1922. (National Library of Ireland listing for this image records the relief agency as the Red Cross. Might also have been the White Cross - of which Maud Gonne was a member).
